sum: AZZ Inc. provides hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating solutions in North America. It operates through the AZZ Metal Coatings; and the AZZ Precoat Metals segments. The company offers metal coating solutions for corrosion protection, including hot-dip galvanizing, spin galvanizing, powder coating, anodizing, and plating to the steel fabrication and other industries. It also provides aesthetic and corrosion protective coatings and related value-added services for steel and aluminum coil primarily serving the construction; appliance; heating, ventilation, and air conditioning; container; transportation; and other end markets. AZZ Inc. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas.
ceo: Mr. Thomas E. Ferguson (President, CEO & Director)
